facts.claim: ACHA is an estimate (retrieval), not a direct measurement
facts.value: File summary: 'The product is derived using a physical retrieval composed of a radiative transfer model that calculates clear sky radiances, which is then used to compute the air temperature at cloud top.' ATBD v3.0 (July 2012) p.12, s.1.6: 'The ACHA is responsible for estimation of vertical extent for all cloudy ABI pixels.'
File lists CMIPC C07, C09, C11, C13, C14, C15, C16 (same scan) and NWP ancillary files as inputs, not band 13 alone
Global attribute license = 'Unclassified data.  Access is restricted to approved users only.' in ACHAC, CMIPC and CODC files. Conflicts with the registry's open-access wording
facts.evidence: ACHAC, CMIPC C13 and CODC downloads

terms.license: NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD) registry page: NOAA data 'disseminated through NODD are open to the public and can be used as desired' (summarising WebFetch, not checked verbatim). The GOES files themselves carry the global attribute quoted in facts; the two conflict. Not legal advice.

limits: One scene only: GOES-19 scan 01:41:17.4 UTC and GOES-18 scan 01:41:17.7 UTC on 2026-10-17. Montana numbers describe that scene.
ACHAC is 10 km at nadir in this file. A search snippet claimed a 2 km ACHA grid since 2023-03-24; not verified.
No ground truth. Height was checked only for internal consistency (DQF, cloud_pixels attribute) and direction against band 13 BT.
BT was sampled at the nearest 2 km cell for each 10 km height cell. Thin or broken cloud makes BT warmer than cloud-top temperature.
Latency is S3 LastModified and filename time, measured here at listing time. It is not an NOAA service level.
One transient proxy SSL EOF on a day-folder listing (GOES-18 2025) and one on a GOES-16 listing; both retried and succeeded. curl header dumps include proxy 'Connection Established' lines.
The own geolocation formula was corrected once during the check (z term carries cos(x)). Final numbers use the corrected version; earlier draft numbers are superseded.
GOES-18 content check covers the ACHAC file only. GOES-18 CMIPC and CODC were listed, not opened.
Registry wording came from a summarising WebFetch. ACHA wording is from the 2012 ATBD v3.0, which may be superseded. The 2023 PUG was not read.
DQF percent attributes are fractions of non-fill pixels. CODC percent_good_quality_qf 0.645 does not reproduce from the DQF bits (0.443 of valid cells).
Geospatial_lat_lon_extent attributes do not match the grid bounds (GOES-19 west edge -152.11 in file vs -150.62 from image bounds).
Downloads total 7.8 MB in four files in the scratch download directory. Nothing is in the repo except this JSON.
open_questions: Is the 2026 ACHAC grid 10 km (as the file says) or 2 km (as one search snippet says)? Needs the PUG L2+ volume.
Does the file licence text ('Unclassified data. Access is restricted to approved users only.') limit redistribution? Needs Carson or counsel.
Why do Montana valid-height cells have warm band 13 BT (median 269.6 K) at median height 11.2 km? Thin cirrus, retrieval bias or 2 km sampling? Needs a recorded high-top case (roadmap phase 2 check).
Why do file geospatial extent attributes differ from grid bounds by up to 1.5 deg in longitude?
Will noaa-goes16 resume ABI output? No data since 2025-04-07.
